role: Optional machinist vendor who fabricates toolkits from ore and scrap.

sprite.notes: Chunky apron sprite with glowing visor. Add looping spark particles during forge animation for readability.

trade.flavor: Assembles a compact toolkit that unlocks advanced crafting options.

behavior.interaction: Sells toolkits when resources are provided. Offers hint about 8-bit forge frequency.

aiGuidance: Allow dialog mutation to emphasize craftsmanship or glitch humor.
